design.carrier_pool: test clips (split_v1 fold -1), any speed; targets = 4 held-out values != own speed

displacement.what: per-step disk position probes (ridge, one per forecast tubelet 4-7) -> |p7 - p4| / 3 px per tubelet -> m/s, then a linear calibration fit on probe clips' forecasts

direct.what: ridge speed probe on the step-mean pooled forecast

direction.what: ridge [sin, cos] probe on the step-mean forecast (off-target check)

readouts.fit_rows: 490 probe clips (folds 3-4), alpha by 5-fold CV inside them; test = 308 clips

keys.predictor.<point>.<condition>.<arm>: forecast of the edited context (frames 1-8, edit on every context token at the point), mean over 4 targets per carrier; per_clip_ci = mean, per-clip SE, 1000-draw clip bootstrap 95% CI, n carriers
keys.<readout>_err_to_target: |speed read from the forecast - target speed| (m/s)
keys.<readout>_err_to_twin_forecast: |speed read from the edited forecast - speed read from the twin's own forecast| (m/s): counterfactual-twin agreement
keys.<readout>_R_speed: per carrier sum_t (s_edit - s_unedited)(target - source) / sum_t (target - source)^2
keys.R_token_twin_forecast: <Z_edit - Z_src, Z_twin - Z_src> / ||Z_twin - Z_src||^2 over the 4 pooled forecast steps (probe-free)
keys.px_to_twin_true / px_to_twin_forecast: native position probes vs the twin's true disk centroids / vs the positions read from the twin's own forecast
keys.dir_change_deg: off-target: |direction read from edited forecast - from unedited forecast|
keys.propagation.<point>: full 16-frame clip edited at the point (own norm), meanpool at every later point read by a speed ridge probe refit there on probe clips' stored meanpool (Part 1 sweep alpha); R_act_twin_change = projection on the twin's real change
keys.twin_reference: the predictor's forecast from the rendered twin's own context (what a perfect edit could reach) and the unedited forecast
